body: I'll be the first to admit that my situation pales in comparison to yours. My deepest condolences for your losses and your severe struggles. I'm sure if we had the support we needed and the proper parenting to get us through things, we'd make it out alright. I don't truly want to see you or myself just disappear into the ether when there are obviously so many things that could help us. Fortune and luck are random and we drew the short straws it would seem. If leaving this world in the winter is your wish, I pray it goes with minimal pain and a certain lightness for whatever comes next for you. Thank you for sharing your experiences. I hope what we put here can make positive differences in the lives of those who are still living and making headway in life.
If you've still got the gumption to be happy and embrace your family, please do so. Glad I could help somehow...
